tools.name: me_get
tools.description: The signed-in person. Call me.start for shops, what this connection can do, and the next tasks.

tools.name: me_start
tools.description: Start here. Shops this connection can use, the grant in plain words, counts, and the next tasks for the state of each shop.

tools.name: jobs_create
tools.description: Start a job at a home, found or created from the address: address is an object, not a string, with required line1, locality, postal_code and jurisdiction (line2 is optional; jurisdiction is an ISO 3166-2 code like US-ID, and a US shop also accepts ID, id, or Idaho), for example {"line1":"100 Test St

tools.name: jobs_list
tools.description: Jobs of a shop you belong to, newest first. A field worker sees only jobs with a visit they are assigned to. A lead also sees jobs their crew is on. Another shop is refused, including a shop token pointed at a different shop. Optional status filter. Shop roles are owner, office, lead and field.

tools.name: quotes_create
tools.description: Create a quote (AI can draft lines; a person who can send quotes approves agent-drafted lines before the quote is sent). Optional: good, better, best options and optional lines the customer picks when signing.

tools.name: quotes_send
tools.description: Lock the quote and get a single-use signing link for the customer (the customer signs on the hosted page; an agent cannot sign or accept a quote). Who may send is shops.sendPermissions: the owner always may, office for any job, a lead for jobs on their crew, and a field worker for jobs assigned to t

tools.name: quotes_revise
tools.description: Pass the COMPLETE new line list; any line you omit is removed. Replace an unsigned quote with a new version. Earlier signing links stop working; send it again for a new link.

tools.name: quotes_list
tools.description: Customer quotes in one shop, newest first. Filter by job_id, status, or both. Read only. Send shop_id or job_id. A shop you are not a member of is refused, and a job you cannot access is not found.

tools.name: invoices_createFromQuote
tools.description: Create an invoice for a signed quote, for the total of the option and optional lines the customer picked. A quote imported as history cannot be invoiced.

tools.name: invoices_send
tools.description: Send an invoice (or the next part of it) and get a single-use pay link. Who may send is shops.sendPermissions: the owner always may, office for any job, a lead for jobs on their crew, and a field worker for jobs assigned to them, until the owner turns that off. Lines an agent drafted stay unsent unt

tools.name: customers_create
tools.description: Add a customer to a shop, with kind, company, email, phone, billing address, lead source, tags and notes in one call.

tools.name: customers_search
tools.description: Find customers by name, company, email, phone or property address.

tools.name: visits_create
tools.description: Book a visit to a job at a time, optionally with the workers going (assignee_ids, a saved crew_id, or both). Overlaps for those workers come back in conflicts.

tools.name: invoices_create
tools.description: Create an invoice without a quote (AI can draft lines; a person who can send invoices approves agent-drafted lines before the invoice is sent). Optional due date, memo and deposit. Send it with invoices.send.

tools.name: invoices_list
tools.description: Invoices in one shop, newest first. Filter by status or by a customer name or invoice id. Read only. A shop you are not a member of is refused. Seeing the amounts needs see_prices, the same as invoices.get.

tools.name: notes_add
tools.description: Write a note on any shop record: a job, visit, photo or video, customer, property, equipment, quote, invoice, request, worker, payment, price book item, maintenance plan or the shop (target_kind and target_id; job_id or visit_id alone also work). Any shop member can. Notes are internal to the shop a

tools.name: ops_search
tools.description: Search all 400+ Doing Work operations (inventory, purchase orders, QuickBooks, payroll, maintenance plans, checklists, phone setup, reports) by keyword. Returns tool names and input schemas to pass to ops_call.

tools.name: ops_call
tools.description: Invoke any Doing Work operation discovered via ops_search (or known by name, e.g. 'po_create' or 'books.export') with its arguments and optional idempotencyKey.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "notes_add" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Write a note on any shop record: a job, visit, photo or video, customer, property, equipment, quote, invoice, request, worker, payment, price book item, mainten…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: customers_search · Private data: jobs_list, quotes_send, invoices_send, notes_add · Public sink: quotes_create, quotes_send, quotes_revise, quotes_list, invoices_send, customers_create, customers_search, invoices_create, notes_add.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: customers_search · Private data: jobs_list, quotes_send, invoices_send, notes_add · Public sink: quotes_create, quotes_send, quotes_revise, quotes_list, invoices_send, customers_create, customers_search, invoices_create, notes_add

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.name: phone_stop

findings.name: phone_connectTwilio

findings.description: The phone numbers in the shop's connected Twilio account, and whether each one already sends its calls or texts somewhere else.

findings.description: Disconnect the shop's Twilio account. The number's old texting and calling settings are put back, and Doing Work stops sending or answering anything for it. Owner only.
